adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, when iterating `for (const destination of event.destinationCalendar)`, the `destination.credentialId` branch tries to resolve a matching credential from `this.calendarCredentials`, then falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique(...)`. If both lookups fail, the code simply exits that iteration without pushing any failure result to `createdEvents` and without logging—because the only creation path is inside `if (credential) { ... createdEvents.push(...) }` and there is no `else` handling for a missing/orphaned credential. This can silently skip creating the calendar event for that destination.
